items.title: Shah meets Albanese, Australia reiterates support for flood-hit Nepal
items.blurb: The Australian prime minister expressed solidarity with Nepal and families of missing Australians during the meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

items.title: Major highways hit by landslides as heavy rain persists
items.blurb: Persistent rain has blocked or restricted several major roads, with authorities imposing overnight closures and warning travellers of further landslide risks.

items.title: Balendra Shah UN speech: Full transcript of Nepal prime minister’s address to the 81st UN General Assembly
items.blurb: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s full UN speech on the Bhotekoshi floods, climate justice, Himalayan cooperation, climate finance and reform of the global order.

items.title: Five takeaways from Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s UN address
items.blurb: The prime minister linked Nepal’s floods to climate risks, proposed cooperation in the Himalayas, and called for fairer climate finance and a more equitable global order.

items.title: Nobody knows how to count a smile like that
items.blurb: A glacier fell in Nepal. In the two weeks that followed, I watched three separate systems fail the same woman.

items.title: Flood-hit women entrepreneurs determined to rebuild their businesses
items.blurb: With family members dead or missing, many women see the need to rise up and find work to support their children and remaining ones.

items.title: Dhunibesi taxes scrap despite constitutional ban
items.blurb: The municipality in Dhading collects Rs3.39 per kg from scrap trucks leaving the Valley, although the constitution bars local governments from taxing goods moving from one jurisdiction to another.

items.title: From flood disaster to climate warning, Shah makes the Himalayas his UN message
items.blurb: Nepal’s prime minister calls for a Himalayan climate-resilience mechanism, more grant-based finance, and stronger regional early-warning systems as climate extremes threaten mountain communities.

items.title: Shah raises climate risks and Bhotekoshi disaster with Guterres
items.blurb: PM seeks UN support for riverbank resettlement, green reconstruction and an extension of Nepal’s LDC graduation timeline.

items.title: At the UN, Shah to bring Nepal’s climate crisis into focus
items.blurb: The world’s youngest national leader makes his UN debut as Nepal seeks greater support for communities bearing the costs of climate disasters.

items.title: What is a ‘super El Niño’ and how will it affect the weather?
items.blurb: A potentially record-strength El Niño could drive extreme heat, floods and droughts worldwide, with major risks to crops, food security and public health.

items.title: Heavy rain prompts travel curbs, school closures across Nepal
items.blurb: Authorities suspend night-time transport, close schools and urge people to postpone travel as heavy rainfall raises the risk of floods and landslides.

items.title: Narayanghat-Muglin road to shut overnight as rain raises landslide risk
items.blurb: Chitwan authorities will halt all traffic from 8pm Thursday to 5am Friday as forecasters warn of heavy rain, floods and landslides across Nepal.

items.title: What Nepal actually needs from global leaders in New York
items.blurb: Former under-secretary-general of the UN argues Balendra Shah’s UNGA debut is a critical pulpit to demand climate justice, secure reconstruction aid and champion the fragile future of the world’s mountains.

items.title: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal seeks greater international support for Nepal’s recovery and climate resilience
items.blurb: Khanal calls for more support for Nepal’s post-disaster recovery, climate-resilient infrastructure, disaster preparedness and financing for climate-vulnerable countries.

items.title: Rasuwa flash floods recede, health risks loom
items.blurb: Reliable systems for providing safe drinking water, sustained hygiene promotion and community awareness programmes are urgently needed.

items.title: At UN, Prime Minister Balendra Shah to make Nepal’s case for climate justice
items.blurb: Shah will cite the Bhotekoshi flood devastation and ask wealthy nations to provide more money, technology and support for reconstruction.
